# Alpha Ahead LLC

> Alpha Ahead LLC is a US-based outsourcing and digital agency (St. Petersburg, Florida; Dubai, UAE; Islamabad, Pakistan) that provides dedicated virtual assistants, appointment setters, B2B cold callers, bookkeeping and executive assistants, property management VAs, lead generation, SEO, web development, digital marketing, graphic design, video editing and IT support to businesses in the US and UAE. Teams work US (EST/PST) and UAE business hours. US real estate staffing (real estate VAs, transaction coordinators, ISAs, real estate cold calling) is handled by its real estate division, Zingo Assist (https://zingoassist.us/).

Contact: info@alphaaheadllc.com · +1 424-542-7170 (US) · +971 4 432 3080 (Dubai) · https://alphaaheadllc.com/contact

## Company identity
- [About Alpha Ahead LLC](https://alphaaheadllc.com/about): Founded by Shehreyar Khan (Director). US-registered (St. Petersburg, FL), offices in Dubai and Islamabad. Leadership, offices, brands and services.

## Services
- [Virtual Assistant Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/virtual-assistant): Dedicated remote assistants for admin, inbox, calendar and CRM management.
- [Appointment Setting Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/appointment-setting): Dedicated setters who follow up leads, qualify them and book meetings into your calendar.
- [Bookkeeping Virtual Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/bookkeeping-virtual-assistant): Daily bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online or Xero, reviewed by your accountant.
- [B2B Cold Calling Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/cold-calling): Outbound prospecting, qualification and meeting booking for B2B and service businesses.
- [Executive Virtual Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/business-assistant): Inbox, calendar, meeting prep and back-office support for founders and leaders.
- [Personal Virtual Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/personal-assistant): Calendar, travel, inbox and life admin.
- [Offshore Virtual Assistant from Pakistan](https://alphaaheadllc.com/hire-virtual-assistant-pakistan): Managed VAs from our Islamabad team with a US contract.
- [Property Management Virtual Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/property-management): Tenant communication, maintenance coordination, leasing and reporting support.
- [Lead Generation](https://alphaaheadllc.com/lead-generation): B2B lead lists, outreach and qualification.
- [SEO Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/seo): Technical, on-page and local SEO.
- [Web Development](https://alphaaheadllc.com/web-development): Fast, SEO-ready websites and web apps.
- [Digital Marketing](https://alphaaheadllc.com/digital-marketing): Paid ads, social media and email marketing.
- [Graphic Design](https://alphaaheadllc.com/graphic-design): Branding, social creatives and marketing design.
- [Video Editing](https://alphaaheadllc.com/video-editing): Reels, YouTube and ad videos.
- [IT Support](https://alphaaheadllc.com/it-support): Remote help desk, Microsoft 365/Google Workspace and cloud support.

Here is a balanced look at time zones, communication, skills, cost factors and reliability so you can choose well.

- [Alpha Medi Assist: A Medical Billing Outsourcing Case Study](https://alphaaheadllc.com/case-studies/alpha-medi-assist): How we built Alpha Medi Assist, a healthcare operations brand that helps providers with medical billing, data management and administrative workflows.
- [Learn with Alpha: An E-Learning Platform Development Case Study](https://alphaaheadllc.com/case-studies/learn-with-alpha): How we built Learn with Alpha, an e-learning platform with flexible, personalized learning paths for students and working professionals.

- [Virtual Assistant Services Dubai: Remote Staffing for UAE SMEs and Startups](https://alphaaheadllc.com/virtual-assistant-dubai): Remote staffing for UAE free zone and mainland companies: admin, appointment setting, bookkeeping support, customer service and IT help, with a Dubai office.
